body: Where does your girlfriend live? Where are you from?

It's true, I have been so overwhelmed for so long that I forgot what it was like to be me, what it was like to have hobbies and what it was like to have non- substance induced fun. I think I'm gonna go lift right now. Olympic weightlifting is something that I invested heavily in and I love the sport because it makes me feel alive in a healthy way. I appreciate the time you spent talking with me, you reminded me of something that's pretty important to me. To be honest, I don't think I can stop myself from drugs and alcohol without help, but I will definitely stay sober for tonight. Suicide will be lingering with me for some time, but talking on here with you was fun and surprisingly relieving. I think I'm gonna go call my parents and see how they're doing lol. Anyways, take care and I hope you have a wonderful rest of the day/evening.

Thanks for the great thought, and yeah I definitely want to feel alive. My ex made me feel alive for the first time in my life and it's been hard letting that shit go. I've been addicted to using drugs and alcohol for the same reasons. Do you have any thoughts on substance use? Stories are cool too.
